rights_available: A brand is interested in this song. Open its Song story & rights page in the music library.
identity_help: Choose a memorable phrase, mood and lead instrument. These choices apply to this whole arrangement and remain in the released audio and MIDI. Compare with Before, or Undo after returning. Transitions need drums in bar 5.
journey_prompt: %s: the first take has character, but some details need work. Choose once for this recording. Listen to the current arrangement or a lighter version first. Retaking keeps the composition; its benefit is production craft, not a new melody. Deadlines still apply.
journey_keep: Keep the take | No delay or fee | Vocal trust +4 | Final quality -2 percentage points
journey_retake: Retake | $600 + 2 idle recording days | Vocal trust -2 | Final quality +6 percentage points
journey_simplify: Simplify | Remove harmony in bars 1-5 | Progress +15 | Final quality -1 percentage point
journey_done_keep: Kept the character of the first take. The vocalists appreciated your trust.
journey_done_retake: Funded a retake: $600 and two recording days invested in craft.
journey_done_simplify: Chose a lighter arrangement to finish sooner; early harmony was removed from the released version.
journey_unavailable: This decision is no longer available.
rights_prompt: A brand wants this song. Offer valid for %d more days. Choose once. Exclusive rights prevent album use and other licensing for 56 days; listening and existing sales remain available. Limited rights pay eight weekly royalties. Keeping it preserves album freedom. Vocal trust changes apply to the credited singers.
rights_option_0: Exclusive: %s now | 56-day album/licensing lock | Vocal trust -8
rights_option_1: Limited: %s now + $300/week for 8 weeks | Album use allowed | Vocal trust +1
rights_option_2: Keep it for the artist | No new money | Album use allowed | Vocal trust +5
rights_done_exclusive: Sold a 56-day exclusive campaign license in exchange for a larger advance.
rights_done_limited: Chose a limited campaign license with eight weekly royalties and album freedom.
rights_done_keep: Kept the song for the artist and declined the campaign money.
rights_locked: Exclusive campaign: %d days remain before album use and other licensing reopen.
rights_album_wait: Not enough unrestricted songs for this album, or this song is still exclusive.
rights_no_offer: No available rights offer. Offers require a 24/40 release with a vocalist and cannot overlap an album or active license.
